description: List editions whose contributor record matches the given at-uri. Resolves via the local contributors index (`subject.uri` containment on each edition's stored `contributors` JSONB). Useful for ID-based aggregation in pages such as "More by these authors" without falling back to fuzzy name search.

errors.name: InvalidContributor
errors.description: The supplied `contributor` is not a valid at-uri for a `community.lexicon.book.contributor` record.
